title: Playing Maxine Sullivan's music; why Pete Brown left
summary: Procope came in to play Maxine's well-made song arrangements; Brown perhaps couldn't adjust to them. He was the last to join and knows nothing of Frankie Newton's departure.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Playing in Lionel Hampton's big band

blocks.x: Now, what happened there? How did that lead to you getting the job? Was Pete leaving anyway, or what happened?

Well, that I don't know. I don't know whether Pete was leaving or not. But I do know that Kirby was looking for someone to play Maxine's music, and all due respect to everybody, when they were recording Maxine they had to get an outside alto player to play the music. So I suppose when I happened on the scene that night, I suppose -- I suppose -- and I sat in, I suppose it was just what he was
looking for. And so my entrance into the band you might say was to play Maxine's music. And whatever happened after that was just, you know, frosting on the cake.
Uh-huh. So but you -- so you don't know why Pete Brown left.

Well, as a matter of fact I know why he left, but I don't know whether it was in the makings before I got there or not. Because Pete certainly was a -- he was really doing what he was doing, as far as playing jazz was concerned. He was a tremendous performer. Yeah. Yeah.
Well, he -- I don't suppose he could make the adjustment to playing the music, Maxine's type of music. That's what I'm trying to explain.

She had all these arrangements which were -- she had a goodly amount of song arrangements and they were well-made, real beautiful arrangements, and they were music. They weren't just thrown together. They weren't out and out -- you know, out and out stomp-down, drag out blues and jazz and that sort of thing. They were well arranged, and if you listen to her records you can tell in a moment.
But Maxine is given as the cause for other people leaving the band too. I think -- let's see, who was there before Charlie Shavers? Was it --
Frankie Newton. It was said that he left because of something over Maxine, some problem.
Well, that I really don't know. Well, you see, they had all gone by the time I got there. By the time I got there the band was formed and it was set, all except for that one chair.
I was the last to join, so I don't know about the -- I don't know what went on before.
